author: Elizabeth Weitzman
quote: [In] this beguiling, darkly comic high school feature... Mager has imbued even the broadest moments with evident empathy. And her bravado, like Meg’s, is undeniably bracing

author: Pete Hammond
quote: A bold idea and a teen-driven movie that could spark the right kind of conversation.

author: Kate Erbland
quote: The film marks the feature film debut of both young stars, and they offer enough gravitas and grace to carry it.

author: Peter Gray
quote: Mager delivers a debut that feels both singular and essential – a film that dares to ask not how we move on, but whether we ever truly can.

author: Dan Tabor
quote: Run Amok is an ambitious and audacious little film that delivers laughs while refusing to shy away from the harder questions beneath them... It’s a delicate balance, but Mager pulls it off.

author: Peyton Robinson
quote: ‘Run Amok’ is a gusty first feature, showing promising style and an astute cultural eye... It meditates on the act of art as freedom... points an adoring eye to our society’s youth, giving them a credit that is generationally looked over.

author: Taylor Gates
quote: Run Amok offers a searing indictment of the “thoughts and prayers” culture that values political correctness over real action... hilariously pitch-perfect in the most jaw-droppingly inappropriate way.

“Run Amok” is a noteworthy exploration of serious themes that will resonate with audiences, particularly in our current climate. It addresses its subject matter with a degree of sincerity that is often lacking in similar narratives.

author: Kristy Puchko
quote: A compelling and oddball coming-of-age comedy, Run Amok is a gem.

author: Collette Garber
quote: Run Amok stands out with its artistic approach to a chilling subject. Run Amok is an odd little film with big ideas, and one thing’s certain: you won’t forget it.

author: Adam Patla
quote: Mager has a lot to say about the world and says it unapologetically... focuses on the healing that comes from art.

author: Kyle Smith
quote: Ms. Marvin’s combination of determination and weirdness lends the film some of the youthful exhilaration of “Rushmore.”

author: Daniel Howat
quote: With challenging themes and a risky approach, there’s a lot to love here... it hits harder than expected.

author: Darren Movie Reviews
quote: Ambitious, powerful and timely, Run Amok left me speechless. A staggering feature debut that is equally heartbreaking, hilarious and uplifting.

author: Dillon Gonzales
quote: I laughed at the dark humor and was moved by the search for catharsis.

author: Sarah Cipley
quote: A deeply funny, awkward, and moving experience on how different generations tackle a trauma... Smart, timely, bold and an experience I won’t forget.

author: Scott Menzel
quote: The film takes major creative swings... deserves to be respected for its willingness to push boundaries and take risks that most films would avoid.
